description: Aires de livraison Naolib de Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Nantes Métropole. Localisation des emplacements réservés à la livraison sur voirie dans un secteur limité à Nantes Métropole. Ces données font suite à un inventaire des aires de stationnement en 2020 - 2021. Ces aires permettent l'enlèvement et la livraison de marchandises par les professionnels et facilitent le transport des marchandises en ville. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are stationnement, auto, Naolib. The portal shows 672 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
